text: Fully on chain computation of citation weighted PageRank allocation is economically feasible at realistic competition sizes, and is far more tractable in gas terms than the validation pool mechanism of the 2018 framework.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Evolution of Domain-Specific Reputation Systems From Binary Validation to Citation-Weighted Knowledge Attribution (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6192998
